rotation.note: One set of up to 100 cards per tab per America/Chicago calendar day. Sets rotate daily. Weekly remix re-partitions/re-pairs images across archive sets so weeks are not identical. If inventory < 100, serve all approved cards only — never invent. Personal Stay/Stray lists stay in localStorage on-device (sos_stay_list / sos_stray_list).

daily_deck.at_100_plus: Each calendar day pick/build a 100-card set; remix weekly so sets are never 100% identical week-to-week

other_tabs_note: Same 100/day + weekly remix after each tab reaches 100 approved. Order after HG: cities → pubs → countries → arenas → beaches → parks → landmarks → islands → luxury.

personal_lists.scope: on-device localStorage only; keyed by place id; survives daily rotation
